description: Cantidad de agua en los embalses de las Cuencas Internas de Catalunya is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Generalitat de Catalunya. Estat dels embassaments de les Conques Internes de Catalunya a partir dels valors de Nivell de l’aigua a l’embassament, Volum embassat i Percentatge del volum embassat respecte la capacitat de l’embassament (dades agregades del dia anterior). Coverage: Generalitat de Catalunya. The portal shows the English title as "Water quantity in the dams of Catalonia Internal Basins" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Generalitat de Catalunya. Its keywords include ods13_acció pel clima, nivell, volum, percentatge, ods6_aigua neta i sanejament, ods12_producció i consum responsable. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-09-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://administraciodigital.gencat.cat/ca/dades/dades-obertes/informacio-practica/llicencies/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
